source_citation: Johnson and Moore (1997), The Pacific Subsurface Countercurrents and an Inertial Model, Journal of Physical Oceanography 27, 2448-2459.
source_access: Relevant abstract/introduction, data methods, section 3 and text Table 1 read from NOAA-hosted full HTML. No figure digitization, historical CTD extraction or full annual-field reconstruction. Added inspection of Rowe et al. section 2 sampling/boundary methods and section 3b general width statement in NOAA PDF, confirmed in publisher full text; no figures or paired edges digitized.
source_locator: Sections 2-3 and Table 1: north SSCC peaks at 155 W 3.5 N/220 m and 110 W 4.5 N/130 m. Transport integration latitude limits and 700-dbar reference are separately defined; they are not route width or a uniform axis layer.
scope: Declared northern Tsuchiya Jet studied reach from the 155 W mean-section core to the 110 W mean-section core. Western formation and basin continuation east of 110 W are excluded. The section gates truncate a larger current; interpolating bends are editor-selected, not a measured continuous centerline or particle path.
layer: Subsurface northern Tsuchiya Jet, distinct from upper-ocean NECC and equatorial EUC. Source Table 1 gives local mean peak depths of 220 m at 155 W and 130 m at 110 W; these are local supports, not a uniform depth or full vertical boundaries.
coordinate_selection: OSW adopts rounded Table 1 core neighborhoods at 155 W 3.5 N and 110 W 4.5 N as truncation gates. Intermediate 140 W 3.8 N and 125 W 4.2 N are editor-selected connections, not digitized axis points. The path neither assigns a whole-current origin/termination nor merges northern/southern jets or NEUC.
remaining_gates: Review interpolation against compatible northern Tsuchiya Jet velocity fields; selected section gates are not origins or terminations.
Resolve western formation and eastward turning/merging separately from this studied reach.
Extract month/depth-resolved axes before annual length or width ranges.
Keep NEUC at 130 E and the southern Tsuchiya branches as distinct identities; no transported-volume-to-length or integration-band-to-width conversion.

reported_ensemble_angular_width.source_locator: Section 3b, printed 1179 / PDF index 7; boundary methodology section 2, printed 1175.
reported_ensemble_angular_width.scope: General meridional SCC width in discussion of stream-coordinate averages; not a separate regional value for each jet.
reported_ensemble_angular_width.boundary_method: Neutral-layer zonal-velocity sign transition where available; subjective local minimum when adjacent eastward currents merge. Paired edges underlying the general 2-degree statement are not extracted.
reported_ensemble_angular_width.sampling_note: Stream-coordinate averaging; spatial bins have uneven time coverage and depth-dependent sampling.
